title: Meadow time-of-day picker and Play the day show for every user; no debug-only controls
context: The Meadow spec of 2026-09-29 kept Play the day and Now debug-only (lib/features/garden/sky/sky_time.dart skyDebugControls). The new prototype puts a time-of-day picker (Now, Morning 8 am, Afternoon 2 pm, Evening 7 pm, Night 11 pm) in the docks and Play the day in the macOS study dock and the phone full screen; the summary named Play the day in the page dock, contradicting the file.
options: picker ships, Play the day stays debug
outcome: Owner: "Match the prototype. I don't need a separate Debug Mode only option." The picker and Play the day appear wherever the prototype shows them, for every user; skyDebugControls is removed and the fast-forward is relabelled Play the day. Replaces the Meadow spec's debug-only decision.
